compute.basis: No code released; agent must reimplement preprocessing (malformed CSV header fix, one-hot encoding, feature presets), GRU autoencoder training on normal-only windows, and Youden-index threshold selection on a 10% validation split; ERENO dataset is public but requires download and cleaning; training a small GRU on ~93% normal traffic is feasible on CPU in under an hour, but exact F1 reproduction is uncertain due to unspecified hyperparameters (epochs, learning rate, batch size, latent dim).
